-36.26967,145.89431: Commemorating the early settlement of the Parish of St James, County of Moira. This plaque marks the original site of 'North Eastern Stores' general store, built in 1882, and The first George J. Coles Store 1910-1913
-36.41134,145.92254: To Commemorate the visit to Goorambat of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II March 5, 1954.
